design.common_mask: X observed AND corresponding field has observed H AND frozen G support[field,time]>0
design.baselines: arithmetic mean of observed H; chronologically last observed H, held constant at every X node
design.primary_scale: Each inner G training-only field scale, identical for all three methods within that G
design.macro: Within outerfold sum error/count per field over relevant inner heldout/validation runs; equal mean over fields with observations, then mean and sample SD across five outerfolds
design.micro: cell-count weighted normalized error; reported separately
design.validation_single_reference: Each of three frozen G scored, same validation company-years repeated across G; no best-G selection
design.validation_mean_trajectory: secondary: arithmetic mean of three raw-unit forecasts on support intersection; outer-training-only scale; not equivalent to classifier probability averaging
design.independence: Inner OOF covers each outer training pool once; company-years repeat in training roles across outerfolds. Not 15 independent trials or a unique combined OOF.
design.history_coverage: per-field observed years (financial any quarter in a year); history_count fields also report number of observed native nodes
design.forecast_horizon: nominal year1..5 of X; additionally actual gap from last H observation is recorded
design.empty_fields: null and omitted from macro, never zero error
design.limitation: last-observation financial baseline has no seasonal adjustment; publication-vintage limitations inherited
